title: Hang on to your flowers
text:
Out of the 55 lines on your 2025 card there are 1,002 unique hands (curious about why? Check out our unique hands post). Each of these has 14 tiles:

14 x 1,002 = 14,028 winning tiles

We can count how many times Flowers appear in these 14,028 winning tiles.

1,329 / 14,028 = 9.5%

Flowers are in high demand!
Let’s compare them to the other tiles.

title: Charleston Strategy: Pass Smart, Not Hard
text:
Quick Charleston Rules

✅ KEEP: 3, 4, 5, 6, F
These appear in 9-10% of winning hands. Hold onto them unless you’re certain about your direction.


🤔 MAYBE KEEP: 2, 7, 8, 9
Mid-demand tiles (6-7%). Good to keep if they fit your emerging pattern.


❌ SAFE TO PASS: Winds
Winds are not in as many hands this season. Pass these first when cleaning house.

title: Charleston Strategy: Pass Smart, Not Hard
text:
💡 Pro Tip
Flowers appear in more winning hands than any number except 5 and 6.

The 2025 Reality: While everyone fights over 5s and 6s, you might find more success building toward hands that use the mid-range numbers (2, 7, 8, 9) that others are passing.

title: 1 is The Loneliest Number
text:
Out of the 55 lines on your 2025 card there are 1,002 unique hands (curious about why? Check out our unique hands post). Each of these has 14 tiles:

14 x 1,002 = 14,028 winning tiles

1 is statistically the LEAST in demand numeric tile!

title: 1 is The Loneliest Number
text:
Why This Matters
While everyone fights over 5s and 6s (each around 10% of the winning tiles), sweet little 1 sits quietly at just 4% - less than half the demand of the popular middle numbers. When you’re deciding between potential hands during gameplay you could:
✅ Target lines that include 1s - you’ll have less competition
✅ Pivot to 1-heavy strategies when middle numbers are scarce

title: 1 is The Loneliest Number
text:
💡 Quick Strategy Tip
Go where others won’t. While your opponents chase the popular 5s and 6s, you can quietly build toward lines featuring 1s with much less resistance.
Here are lines that can work with a 1 strategy that don’t need a 5 or 6:



13579 - Line 4
Any Like Numbers - Lines 1 - 3
Consecutive Run - Line 2 - Line 3 - Line 5 - Line 6 - Line 8
Quints - Lines 1 - 3
Singles & Pairs - Line 1 - Line 4
Winds & Dragons - Line 2 - Line 5
